id-20260913-news-2.title: Rupiah Weakens to Become the Weakest in Asia, JCI Also Pressured Ahead of The Fed's Interest Rate Decision

segments.src: ## Rupiah Tertekan ke Level Rp17.622 per Dolar AS
segments.tr: ## Rupiah Pressured to the Level of Rp17,622 per USD

segments.src: Nilai tukar rupiah kembali mengalami tekanan signifikan terhadap dolar Amerika Serikat, dengan level perdagangan bergerak di kisaran Rp17.622 per dolar AS.
segments.tr: The rupiah exchange rate experienced significant pressure against the United States dollar, with trading levels moving around the range of Rp17,622 per US dollar.

segments.src: Pelemahan ini membuat rupiah tercatat sebagai salah satu mata uang dengan kinerja terlemah di kawasan Asia dalam periode perdagangan terkini.
segments.tr: This weakening has recorded the rupiah as one of the currencies with the weakest performance in the Asian region during the recent trading period.

segments.src: Pelemahan mata uang domestik ini terjadi di tengah dinamika pasar keuangan global yang cenderung berhati-hati.
segments.tr: The weakening of the domestic currency occurs amidst the dynamics of global financial markets that tend to be cautious.

segments.src: Para pelaku pasar tampak menahan diri dari mengambil posisi besar sembari menunggu kejelasan arah kebijakan moneter dari bank sentral Amerika Serikat, Federal Reserve (The Fed), yang dijadwalkan mengumumkan keputusan suku bunga acuan pekan ini.
segments.tr: Market participants appear to hold back from taking large positions while waiting for clarity on the direction of monetary policy from the US central bank, the Federal Reserve (The Fed), which is scheduled to announce its benchmark interest rate decision this week.

segments.src: ## IHSG Ikut Melemah Lebih dari 1 Persen
segments.tr: ## JCI Also Weakens by More Than 1 Percent

segments.src: Sentimen pelemahan tidak hanya dirasakan di pasar valuta asing.
segments.tr: The sentiment of weakening is not only felt in the foreign exchange market.

segments.src: Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) di Bursa Efek Indonesia turut terkoreksi lebih dari 1 persen dalam perdagangan yang berlangsung.
segments.tr: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) on the Indonesia Stock Exchange also corrected by more than 1 percent in ongoing trading.

segments.src: Tekanan pada indeks saham ini sejalan dengan aksi jual bersih (net sell) yang dilakukan investor asing di pasar modal domestik.
segments.tr: The pressure on the stock index is in line with net selling actions carried out by foreign investors in the domestic capital market.

segments.src: Beberapa analis pasar menilai bahwa kombinasi pelemahan rupiah dan koreksi IHSG mencerminkan sikap wait and see investor terhadap arah kebijakan moneter global.
segments.tr: Several market analysts assess that the combination of the rupiah's weakening and the JCI correction reflects a wait-and-see attitude of investors towards the direction of global monetary policy.

segments.src: Ketidakpastian ini mendorong sebagian pelaku pasar mengalihkan dananya ke aset-aset yang dianggap lebih aman.
segments.tr: This uncertainty encourages some market participants to shift their funds to assets considered safer.

segments.src: ## Faktor Penyebab: Ketidakpastian Kebijakan The Fed
segments.tr: ## Causal Factors: The Fed Policy Uncertainty

segments.src: Sejumlah faktor disebut turut memengaruhi pergerakan pasar keuangan domestik, di antaranya:
segments.tr: A number of factors are said to influence the movement of the domestic financial market, including:

segments.src: - **Ekspektasi pasar terhadap keputusan suku bunga The Fed** yang masih beragam, menciptakan ketidakpastian arah suku bunga acuan global.
segments.tr: - **Market expectations regarding The Fed's interest rate decision** which are still diverse, creating uncertainty in the direction of the global benchmark interest rate.

segments.src: - **Penguatan indeks dolar AS** secara umum terhadap sejumlah mata uang utama dan mata uang negara berkembang di kawasan Asia.
segments.tr: - **The strengthening of the US dollar index** in general against a number of major currencies and developing country currencies in the Asian region.

segments.src: - **Arus keluar modal asing (capital outflow)** dari pasar saham dan obligasi domestik yang menambah tekanan pada nilai tukar rupiah.
segments.tr: - **Foreign capital outflows** from the domestic stock and bond markets which add pressure to the rupiah exchange rate.

segments.src: - **Sentimen risk-off global**, di mana investor cenderung mengurangi eksposur pada aset berisiko menjelang kepastian kebijakan moneter.
segments.tr: - **Global risk-off sentiment**, where investors tend to reduce exposure to risky assets ahead of monetary policy certainty.

segments.src: ## Respons dan Langkah Antisipasi
segments.tr: ## Response and Anticipation Steps

segments.src: Otoritas moneter di Indonesia umumnya memiliki sejumlah instrumen untuk menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar, termasuk intervensi pasar dan penguatan koordinasi kebijakan fiskal-moneter.
segments.tr: Monetary authorities in Indonesia generally have a number of instruments to maintain exchange rate stability, including market intervention and strengthening fiscal-monetary policy coordination.

segments.src: Pelaku pasar dan pengamat ekonomi menyarankan agar masyarakat serta pelaku usaha mencermati perkembangan ini secara proporsional, mengingat pergerakan nilai tukar dan indeks saham merupakan bagian dari dinamika pasar keuangan yang lazim terjadi, khususnya menjelang keputusan kebijakan moneter penting seperti pertemuan The Fed.
segments.tr: Market participants and economic observers suggest that the public and business actors observe these developments proportionally, considering that exchange rate and stock index movements are part of common financial market dynamics, especially ahead of important monetary policy decisions such as The Fed meeting.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Perlu Diperhatikan Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## What to Pay Attention to Next

segments.src: Hasil keputusan suku bunga The Fed pekan ini akan menjadi salah satu faktor penentu arah pergerakan pasar keuangan dalam waktu dekat, baik bagi nilai tukar rupiah maupun kinerja IHSG.
segments.tr: The outcome of The Fed's interest rate decision this week will be one of the determining factors for the direction of financial market movements in the near future, both for the rupiah exchange rate and the JCI performance.

segments.src: Para pengamat menyarankan agar investor tetap mencermati data ekonomi domestik dan global, serta memperhatikan diversifikasi portofolio sebagai bagian dari strategi pengelolaan risiko di tengah kondisi pasar yang dinamis.
segments.tr: Observers suggest that investors continue to monitor domestic and global economic data, as well as pay attention to portfolio diversification as part of risk management strategies amidst dynamic market conditions.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun untuk tujuan informasi umum dan tidak dimaksudkan sebagai saran investasi.
segments.tr: *This article is compiled for general information purposes and is not intended as investment advice.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan untuk melakukan analisis lebih lanjut atau berkonsultasi dengan penasihat keuangan sebelum mengambil keputusan investasi.*
segments.tr: Readers are advised to conduct further analysis or consult with a financial advisor before making investment decisions.*

id-20260913-news-1.title: Prabowo Attends 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, Discusses Economic Cooperation with Modi, Putin, and Xi Jinping

segments.src: Presiden Prabowo Subianto dijadwalkan menghadiri Konferensi Tingkat Tinggi (KTT) BRICS ke-18 yang berlangsung di New Delhi, India, pada 12-13 September 2026.
segments.tr: President Prabowo Subianto is scheduled to attend the 18th BRICS Summit taking place in New Delhi, India, on September 12-13, 2026.

segments.src: Dalam forum multilateral ini, Prabowo melakukan sejumlah pertemuan bilateral dengan pemimpin negara anggota BRICS, termasuk Perdana Menteri India Narendra Modi, Presiden Rusia Vladimir Putin, dan Presiden China Xi Jinping.
segments.tr: In this multilateral forum, Prabowo held a number of bilateral meetings with leaders of BRICS member countries, including Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

segments.src: ## Fokus Pembahasan: Pangan, Energi, dan Ekonomi
segments.tr: ## Focus of Discussion: Food, Energy, and Economy

segments.src: Sesuai agenda resmi, pertemuan-pertemuan tersebut menitikberatkan pada penguatan kerja sama di tiga sektor utama, yaitu ketahanan pangan, keamanan energi, dan pengembangan ekonomi antarnegara berkembang.
segments.tr: In accordance with the official agenda, these meetings focused on strengthening cooperation in three main sectors, namely food security, energy security, and economic development among developing countries.

segments.src: Ketiga isu ini menjadi perhatian bersama negara-negara anggota BRICS di tengah dinamika perekonomian global yang terus berubah.
segments.tr: These three issues have become a shared concern for BRICS member countries amidst the ever-changing dynamics of the global economy.

segments.src: Indonesia, yang resmi bergabung sebagai anggota penuh BRICS, memanfaatkan momentum KTT ini untuk memperluas jejaring kerja sama dengan negara-negara mitra strategis.
segments.tr: Indonesia, which has officially joined as a full member of BRICS, is utilizing the momentum of this summit to expand its cooperation network with strategic partner countries.

segments.src: Delegasi Indonesia turut membahas peluang peningkatan investasi, perdagangan, serta kolaborasi di bidang teknologi dan energi terbarukan.
segments.tr: The Indonesian delegation also discussed opportunities for increasing investment, trade, and collaboration in the fields of technology and renewable energy.

segments.src: ## Pertemuan Bilateral dengan Pemimpin Negara Anggota
segments.tr: ## Bilateral Meetings with Member State Leaders

segments.src: Dalam pertemuan dengan PM Modi, kedua pihak dilaporkan membahas peluang perluasan kerja sama ekonomi dan investasi antara Indonesia dan India, dua negara dengan populasi besar dan pasar domestik yang terus berkembang.
segments.tr: In the meeting with PM Modi, both parties reportedly discussed opportunities for expanding economic cooperation and investment between Indonesia and India, two countries with large populations and continuously growing domestic markets.

segments.src: Sementara itu, pertemuan dengan Presiden Putin turut menyinggung potensi kerja sama di sektor energi, mengingat Rusia merupakan salah satu produsen energi utama dunia.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, the meeting with President Putin also touched upon the potential for cooperation in the energy sector, given that Russia is one of the world's major energy producers.

segments.src: Adapun pertemuan dengan Presiden Xi Jinping berfokus pada penguatan hubungan ekonomi Indonesia-China yang selama ini telah terjalin di berbagai sektor.
segments.tr: The meeting with President Xi Jinping focused on strengthening the Indonesia-China economic relationship that has already been established across various sectors.

segments.src: ## Arti Penting BRICS bagi Indonesia
segments.tr: ## The Significance of BRICS for Indonesia

segments.src: BRICS merupakan forum kerja sama yang beranggotakan negara-negara ekonomi berkembang dan pasar baru (emerging markets).
segments.tr: BRICS is a cooperation forum consisting of developing economies and emerging markets.

segments.src: Keikutsertaan Indonesia dalam forum ini dipandang sebagai bagian dari strategi diplomasi ekonomi untuk memperluas akses pasar, sumber pembiayaan pembangunan, serta kemitraan strategis di luar jalur kerja sama konvensional.
segments.tr: Indonesia's participation in this forum is seen as part of an economic diplomacy strategy to expand market access, sources of development financing, and strategic partnerships outside of conventional cooperation channels.

segments.src: Pemerintah menegaskan bahwa partisipasi aktif dalam KTT BRICS sejalan dengan prinsip politik luar negeri bebas aktif, di mana Indonesia tetap menjalin hubungan baik dengan berbagai blok ekonomi global tanpa memihak pada kepentingan geopolitik tertentu.
segments.tr: The government emphasized that active participation in the BRICS Summit is in line with the free and active foreign policy principle, where Indonesia continues to maintain good relations with various global economic blocs without siding with specific geopolitical interests.

segments.src: Hasil konkret dari rangkaian pertemuan di New Delhi ini diperkirakan akan disampaikan lebih lanjut oleh Kementerian Luar Negeri dan kementerian terkait setelah rangkaian KTT selesai, termasuk tindak lanjut berupa nota kesepahaman maupun rencana kerja sama teknis antarnegara.
segments.tr: Concrete results from the series of meetings in New Delhi are expected to be conveyed further by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and relevant ministries after the summit series concludes, including follow-ups in the form of memorandums of understanding or technical cooperation plans between countries.

id-20260913-news-3.title: Rp5 Million Electric Motorcycle Subsidy Targeted to Disburse September 2026, Purbaya: Can Be Q3-Q4 Economic Booster

segments.src: Pemerintah dikabarkan mulai menyalurkan subsidi pembelian motor listrik senilai Rp5 juta per unit pada September 2026.
segments.tr: The government is reportedly starting to distribute subsidies for the purchase of electric motorcycles worth Rp5 million per unit in September 2026.

segments.src: Kebijakan ini disebut menjadi salah satu instrumen yang diandalkan Menteri Keuangan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa untuk mendorong laju pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional di paruh kedua tahun ini, khususnya pada kuartal III dan kuartal IV.
segments.tr: This policy is said to be one of the instruments relied upon by Minister of Finance Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa to boost the pace of national economic growth in the second half of this year, especially in the third and fourth quarters.

segments.src: ## Latar Belakang Kebijakan
segments.tr: ## Policy Background

segments.src: Subsidi kendaraan listrik roda dua bukan hal baru dalam kebijakan pemerintah untuk mendorong transisi energi dan elektrifikasi transportasi.
segments.tr: Two-wheeled electric vehicle subsidies are not new in government policy to encourage energy transition and transportation electrification.

segments.src: Namun, rencana pencairan subsidi Rp5 juta per unit pada September 2026 ini menarik perhatian karena disampaikan berbarengan dengan upaya pemerintah menjaga momentum konsumsi rumah tangga di tengah tantangan perekonomian global maupun domestik.
segments.tr: However, the plan to disburse the Rp5 million subsidy per unit in September 2026 is drawing attention because it was announced simultaneously with government efforts to maintain household consumption momentum amid global and domestic economic challenges.

segments.src: Menurut informasi yang berkembang, payung hukum atau petunjuk teknis resmi terkait mekanisme penyaluran subsidi ini disebut masih dalam proses penyusunan oleh instansi terkait.
segments.tr: According to developing information, the legal umbrella or official technical guidelines regarding the subsidy distribution mechanism are still in the process of being drafted by relevant agencies.

segments.src: Artinya, detail teknis seperti syarat penerima, kuota unit, jenis motor listrik yang memenuhi kriteria, hingga cara pengajuan kemungkinan masih dapat berubah sebelum aturan resminya diterbitkan.
segments.tr: This means that technical details such as recipient requirements, unit quotas, types of electric motorcycles meeting criteria, and application methods may still change before the official rules are issued.

segments.src: ## Pernyataan Purbaya Soal Dampak ke Ekonomi
segments.tr: ## Purbaya's Statement on Economic Impact

segments.src: Dalam berbagai kesempatan, Purbaya kerap menekankan pentingnya menjaga daya beli masyarakat sebagai salah satu penopang utama pertumbuhan ekonomi.
segments.tr: On various occasions, Purbaya has frequently emphasized the importance of maintaining public purchasing power as one of the main pillars of economic growth.

segments.src: Subsidi motor listrik ini disebut-sebut menjadi salah satu bagian dari rangkaian stimulus yang diharapkan dapat menggerakkan sektor riil, mulai dari industri manufaktur kendaraan listrik, rantai pasok komponen, hingga sektor jasa pembiayaan.
segments.tr: This electric motorcycle subsidy is rumored to be part of a series of stimuli expected to move the real sector, ranging from the electric vehicle manufacturing industry, component supply chains, to the financing services sector.

segments.src: Dengan menyasar segmen kendaraan listrik, kebijakan ini juga diklaim sejalan dengan agenda besar pemerintah dalam mendorong transisi energi bersih sekaligus mengurangi konsumsi bahan bakar minyak bersubsidi.
segments.tr: By targeting the electric vehicle segment, this policy is also claimed to be in line with the government's grand agenda in pushing the clean energy transition while reducing the consumption of subsidized fuel oil.

segments.src: Meski demikian, publik perlu mencatat bahwa proyeksi dampak terhadap pertumbuhan ekonomi kuartal III dan IV tersebut merupakan pandangan dan target dari pihak pemerintah, sehingga realisasinya akan sangat bergantung pada berbagai faktor lain, termasuk kondisi ekonomi global, daya beli masyarakat, dan kecepatan implementasi program di lapangan.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, the public needs to note that the projection of the impact on third and fourth-quarter economic growth is a view and target from the government side, so its realization will heavily depend on various other factors, including global economic conditions, public purchasing power, and the speed of program implementation on the ground.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Diperhatikan Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## What the Public Needs to Pay Attention To

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat yang berencana memanfaatkan subsidi ini, ada beberapa hal yang sebaiknya diperhatikan:
segments.tr: For the public planning to utilize this subsidy, there are several things that should be noted:

segments.src: - **Tunggu aturan resmi.** Karena regulasi teknis disebut belum final, calon pembeli motor listrik disarankan untuk tidak terburu-buru mengambil keputusan finansial hanya berdasarkan wacana awal, dan menunggu pengumuman resmi dari kementerian atau lembaga yang berwenang.
segments.tr: - **Wait for official rules.** Since technical regulations are said to be not yet final, prospective electric motorcycle buyers are advised not to rush into financial decisions based solely on initial discourse, and to wait for official announcements from authorized ministries or institutions.

segments.src: - **Cek kelayakan unit.** Biasanya program subsidi kendaraan listrik mensyaratkan unit motor terdaftar dalam daftar model yang memenuhi standar tingkat komponen dalam negeri (TKDN) tertentu.
segments.tr: - **Check unit eligibility.** Usually, electric vehicle subsidy programs require motorcycle units to be registered in the list of models meeting certain domestic component level (TKDN) standards.

segments.src: - **Pantau kanal resmi.** Informasi resmi soal jadwal, kuota, dan cara pendaftaran subsidi sebaiknya dipantau melalui situs atau kanal resmi pemerintah agar terhindar dari informasi yang belum terverifikasi maupun potensi penipuan yang mengatasnamakan program subsidi.
segments.tr: - **Monitor official channels.** Official information regarding the schedule, quota, and registration method for the subsidy should be monitored through official government websites or channels to avoid unverified information and potential fraud under the guise of the subsidy program.

segments.src: ## Menanti Kepastian Aturan
segments.tr: ## Awaiting Regulatory Certainty

segments.src: Sampai saat ini, publik masih menunggu kepastian lebih lanjut mengenai payung hukum dan mekanisme teknis penyaluran subsidi motor listrik tersebut.
segments.tr: Until now, the public is still waiting for further certainty regarding the legal umbrella and technical mechanism for distributing the electric motorcycle subsidy.

segments.src: Kejelasan aturan ini penting agar program dapat berjalan tepat sasaran dan benar-benar memberikan efek pengganda terhadap perekonomian sebagaimana yang diharapkan oleh pemerintah.
segments.tr: The clarity of these rules is important so that the program can run on target and truly provide a multiplier effect on the economy as expected by the government.

segments.src: Masyarakat maupun pelaku industri kendaraan listrik disarankan untuk terus mengikuti perkembangan kebijakan ini melalui sumber-sumber resmi, mengingat rincian program masih dapat berubah hingga aturan resminya benar-benar diterbitkan.
segments.tr: The public and electric vehicle industry players are advised to continue following the development of this policy through official sources, considering that program details may still change until the official rules are truly issued.
